title: Righe e celle
code:
from openpyxl import Workbook
wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.append(["d", "A"])
ws.append([10, 78.5])
print(ws.max_row, ws["B2"].value, ws.cell(row=1, column=1).value)
codeHtml: from openpyxl import Workbook wb = Workbook() ws = wb.active ws.append(["d", "A"]) ws.append([10, 78.5]) print(ws.max_row, ws["B2"].value, ws.cell(row=1, column=1).value)
explain: append scrive una riga alla volta. Le celle si leggono con la notazione di Excel ("B2") o con cell(row, column), numerati da 1.
